feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.subtitle: Shapes what we build next
feedback.sentBody: A pre-filled email just opened — hit send and it lands with us. If nothing opened, email <0>{{email}}</0> directly.
feedback.placeholderBug: What did you do, and what happened instead?
feedback.placeholderIdea: What would make {{app}} better for you?
feedback.placeholderOther: Share anything — the good, the rough, the wishlist.

cueEditor.title: Cue point editor
cueEditor.noTrack: Select a track in the set timeline, then open the cue editor.
cueEditor.saveCueError: Could not save cue — try again.

architect.noLibraryBody: Set Architect builds a full set for you — picking tracks that flow on key, BPM and energy across the night. Import your library so it has tracks to work with.
architect.nlNoMatch: Couldn’t read that — try “2-hour peak club set, 126–130”.
architect.lockedNote_one: {{count}} locked track will stay in place
architect.lockedNote_other: {{count}} locked tracks will stay in place
architect.noTracksMatched: No tracks matched — try widening the BPM range or duration.
architect.buildFailed: Build failed. Try adjusting your BPM range or duration.
architect.resultIntro_one: Here’s one possible {{count}}-track set — every build is a valid arrangement. Regenerate for another take.
architect.resultIntro_other: Here’s one possible {{count}}-track set — every build is a valid arrangement. Regenerate for another take.
architect.seedLockedTitle: Seed locked — rebuilds the same set
architect.lockSeed: Lock seed — Regenerate reproduces this set instead of a new take
architect.invalidSeed: That doesn’t look like a valid seed.
architect.seedHint: Same seed and settings reproduce this set — as long as your library hasn’t changed.

comingSoon.body: Coming in Phase {{phase}}. This feature is on the roadmap and will be ready soon.

onboarding.welcomeBody: {{app}} reads your existing DJ library and helps you build sets that flow — which track plays next, and whether it’ll sound clean. Let’s load your music.
onboarding.proficiencyTitle: How much DJ experience do you have?
onboarding.proficiencyBody: We’ll tune the explanations to match.
onboarding.newBody: Plain-language tips appear the first time you see each thing — keys, BPM, energy, transitions. They’re free and stay on, so the app never feels like jargon.
onboarding.experiencedBody: Keep the UI minimal. Learn Mode stays off — flip it on anytime in Settings if you’re teaching or reviewing a tricky transition.
onboarding.findBody: We’ll look for Rekordbox or Serato on this Mac and load your tracks automatically.
onboarding.findHint: Or load a Rekordbox XML export if you prefer.

upgrade.tagline: The memory behind every set you play.
upgrade.checkoutError: We couldn’t open checkout. Check your connection and try again — or paste a licence key below.
upgrade.successBody: Everything’s unlocked. Thanks for backing {{app}} — go build something great.
upgrade.trialEndsTomorrow: Your free trial ends <0>tomorrow</0> — upgrade to keep everything unlocked.
upgrade.trialEndsInDays_one: Your free trial ends in <0>{{count}} day</0> — upgrade to keep everything unlocked.
upgrade.trialEndsInDays_other: Your free trial ends in <0>{{count}} days</0> — upgrade to keep everything unlocked.
upgrade.trialEnded: Your free trial has <0>ended</0> — upgrade to unlock suggestions, Set Architect, Recall and export again.
upgrade.trustLine: Secure checkout via Lemon Squeezy · Instant activation
upgrade.lifetimeHero: Own {{app}} forever — every future update included.
upgrade.tipBlurb: {{app}} is built by one person. If it’s saved you time, a tip keeps it going — totally optional.
upgrade.restoreHint: Already bought {{app}} Pro? Restore it with your licence key.

activationError.malformed: That key doesn’t look right — check for a typo and try again.
activationError.badSignature: We couldn’t verify that key. Re-paste it, or contact support.
activationError.expired: That subscription has lapsed. Renew it to restore Pro.
activationError.deviceMismatch: That key is active on another device. Deactivate it there first, or contact support to move it.
activationError.revoked: That key was cancelled or refunded. If that’s unexpected, contact support.
activationError.unknown: Something went wrong activating that key. Try again, or contact support.

export.noSet: No set loaded. Build or load a set first.
export.chooseIntro: Choose what to export. Either option writes a brand-new file you pick the location for — your existing library is never modified.
export.cardXmlBody_one: An <0>.xml</0> you import into Rekordbox or copy to a USB drive. Carries cue points, hot cues, BPM and key for all {{count}} track.
export.cardXmlBody_other: An <0>.xml</0> you import into Rekordbox or copy to a USB drive. Carries cue points, hot cues, BPM and key for all {{count}} tracks.
export.cardEngineBody: Writes a gig-ready Engine Library straight to a USB drive — copies the audio and builds the database so it plays plug-and-play on Denon gear. Denon re-analyses beatgrids on load.
export.cardBeatportBody: A <0>.csv</0> ready for Beatport’s playlist import (or Soundiiz / TuneMyMusic). {{app}} matches each track by ISRC, title and artist, then flags anything that needs a quick manual fix.
export.idleBody: Creates a Rekordbox-compatible XML file you can import back into Rekordbox or copy directly to a USB drive.
export.idleNotModified: Your existing Rekordbox library is not modified.
export.willCheck_one: {{app}} will check all {{count}} track is compatible before exporting.
export.willCheck_other: {{app}} will check all {{count}} tracks are compatible before exporting.
export.usbPickerBody_one: Choose the USB drive to write your Engine Library to. {{app}} copies your {{count}} track onto the drive — make sure it has enough free space.
export.usbPickerBody_other: Choose the USB drive to write your Engine Library to. {{app}} copies your {{count}} tracks onto the drive — make sure it has enough free space.
export.noUsb: No USB drives detected. Plug one in and it’ll appear here.
export.blockingTitle: Blocking issues — must fix to export
export.missingFileHint: Every track must be linked to a real local file before export — a CDJ can’t play a track that isn’t on the drive. Buy or download phantom tracks and import them, or relink missing files from the Recall tab’s Library health section.
export.doneHintEngine: Eject the drive and plug it into your Denon gear, or import it into Engine DJ. Beatgrids are analysed on load. Your library is not modified.
export.doneHintXml: Import this file into Rekordbox, or copy it to a USB drive using the buttons below. Your existing Rekordbox library is not modified.

error.usbDisconnected: That USB drive is no longer connected.
error.proRequired: Exporting is a SetRecord Pro feature.

beatport.reviewHint: Rows with an ISRC match exactly. For the rest, tidy the title/artist or add an ISRC below — edits only change the CSV, never your library.

identity.title: Your DJ fingerprint is ready
identity.sub: {{app}} has enough data to paint your sound. Share it or keep it to yourself.

import.title: Import library
import.rekordboxOpenBody: Quit Rekordbox so {{app}} can read its library, then try again.
import.dbReadErrorBody: This may be a newer Rekordbox version we don’t yet support. Use the XML export below — same result, takes 30 seconds.
import.emptyBody: Add some tracks in Rekordbox first, then come back here.
import.readOnlyNote: {{app}} reads your Rekordbox library read-only. Your Rekordbox file is never modified.
import.reimportNote: Re-importing updates existing tracks and adds new ones. Energy analysis and cue points you’ve set in {{app}} are preserved.
import.consentBody: {{app}} will read your Rekordbox library directly. It opens master.db read-only, never writes to it, and never sends your data anywhere.
import.consentNote: You’ll only see this once. You can switch to XML import any time.
import.genericError: Something went wrong with the last import. Try again or use a different file.
import.notFoundBody: We couldn’t find Rekordbox on this Mac.
import.alreadyHaveExport: Already have an export? Choose your XML file →
import.whatsExportBody: It’s a single file that lists every track in your collection — BPM, key, cue points and all. {{app}} reads it to map out your music. It stays on your Mac, and your Rekordbox library is never changed.
import.orImportXml: Or import a Rekordbox XML file →

source.which: Which DJ software do you use? {{app}} reads your library read-only.
source.closeAndRetry: Close the app and try again
source.unsupported: Not available on this platform yet
source.readOnlyNote: {{app}} reads your {{label}} library read-only. Cue points, hot cues and beatgrids are imported in a background pass shortly after.
source.betaNote: {{label}} import is in beta and hasn’t been tested on real Denon hardware. Cues, beatgrids and musical keys aren’t imported yet — please report anything that looks off.
